Military Ministry headquarters is located in Newport

WWW.VALORMOVEMENT.COM
SIX STEPS TO LAUNCH A VALOR MOVEMENT
Pray. Invest time in prayer with like-minded
friends, asking God to guide you each step of the way.
Remember to talk to God about people before you talk
to people about God.
Valor is the ROTC cadet and midshipman ministry
of Campus Crusade for Christ. Valor movements
benefit from being under the local campus ministry
leadership, with additional coaching and resources
provided by Military Ministry. Valor works in
partnership with Officers’ Christian Fellowship to
resource and equip Christ-centered, spiritually fit
officers for our U.S. military equipping them to win,
build and send fellow servicemen.
Connect with your Valor staff coach. They’ll
information about reaching your unit for Christ. If
Campus Crusade for Christ staff members are on
campus, you will also want to initiate with touch with
them.
Communicate with your ROTC cadre (faculty). Let
them know: What Valor is and what we offer them.
Publicize. By using Cadet & Midshipman Survival
Kits (CMSKs) and posters.
MILITARY CAMPUS MINISTRY
It is the vision of Military Campus Ministry to reach
our future military leaders for Christ at their initial
entry points at our U.S. service academies and the
more than 270 Reserve Officer Training Corps
(ROTC) college campuses. We help them grow in their
faith and help them become disciple makers around
the world at their future duty assignments.
Gather interested students together. Start weekly
discipleship groups and begin forming the core
leadership group.
Involve further. Show students how to communicate
their faith in Christ to others. Help them make
appointments to talk with their friends about Christ.
Along with other divisions of The Military Ministry
of Campus Crusade for Christ International, our
focus is to help reach the world through the military
of the world; to help military men and women and
their families in all nations become followers of Jesus
Christ.
